recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13730; future supplement behavior changes should be handled through the later supplement-specific issues.
issue_request: FHIR-13730 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary issue asking for CodeSystem supplement support: a CodeSystem supplements reference showing that a resource adds designations/properties for another code system, plus a ValueSet extension to declare supplement dependencies.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 12754. Git-svn commit 150856d8859042d7573e24a26e24a325f9a954bc added CodeSystem.supplements and content mode supplement, and 6507225d371fca0646f6ef59c79dc3158eb41a09 added the ValueSet supplement extension source.
additional_context: Later terminology decisions refined the mechanism without reversing it: FHIR-15808 changed terminology extension targets from Reference to canonical, FHIR-33319 added the csd-4 invariant, FHIR-37529 added useSupplement operation parameters, and valueset-supplement is now defined in the FHIR Extension Pack. CodeSystem and ValueSet are active resources in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current CodeSystem source describes supplements, includes CodeSystem.content = supplement, defines CodeSystem.supplements 0..1 canonical(CodeSystem), enforces csd-4, and has narrative/examples. Current ValueSet source and the Extension Pack define the supplement dependency declaration pathway.

related_jiras.note: Changed terminology references such as valueset-supplement from Reference(CodeSystem) to canonical(CodeSystem), explaining the current type difference from the original request.
Added the invariant requiring CodeSystem.supplements when content = supplement; already represented on the combined branch.
Addressed standards-status handling for CodeSystem.supplements; already represented on the combined branch.
Added useSupplement operation parameters as a dynamic supplement declaration path; already represented on the combined branch.
Expanded valueset-supplement extension contexts in the FHIR Extension Pack.
Clarifies that ValueSet compose include/exclude must not directly reference CodeSystem supplements; audited as an opportunistic companion issue.
